note: Locked before any test extraction (gate lock_schema). Every outcome row must use exactly these categories. Use 'other' and explain in notes rather than inventing a category. Changing this file after the lock invalidates the run. Every count put in 'other' needs a plain description in notes; harness/other_review.py lists them each round. New categories go in the next schema version.

planaria_ap_polarity.description: Anterior-posterior identity of regenerated fragments, scored at the end of regeneration.

planaria_cryptic.description: Outcome when normal-looking regenerates from a treated population are re-cut with no further treatment.

planaria_head_shape.description: Head morphology of regenerates, e.g. species-specific head shape shifts.

planaria_eyes.description: Eye number and placement in regenerates.

xenopus_lr_asymmetry.description: Left-right placement of heart, gut and gall bladder.

xenopus_eye.description: Eye formation, including ectopic eyes outside the head.

xenopus_tail_regeneration.description: Tail regeneration after amputation, scored by the paper's own index or a simple three-level call.

other_family.description: Use only if an eligible experiment fits no family. Log every use; propose a new family only before the lock.

zebrafish_embryo_morphology.description: Embryo/larva malformation calls from screens or papers (axis, craniofacial, fin, edema, pigment).

fin_size_regeneration.description: Fin size or regrowth after amputation.

mammal_developmental_tox.description: Malformation findings from knockouts or developmental toxicity studies, grouped by the region affected.

human_channelopathy_anatomy.description: Developmental anatomy reported for a channel gene variant (HPO terms grouped). Used for cross-species direction checks, not scored as probabilities unless counts exist.
